audience: publishers and newsletter writers who run a Ghost site with paid memberships

useCases.title: Review drafts and published posts
useCases.text: List the posts filtered by status, such as drafts. Open one post to read its body and its last update time.

useCases.title: Draft a new post from an outline
useCases.text: Read the existing tags first, then create a draft post from HTML. The draft is never published and no email is sent. Publish it in Ghost Admin.

useCases.title: Edit the text of a post
useCases.text: Read the post to get its update time. Change its title, HTML, excerpt or tags. The status does not change and no email is sent.

useCases.title: Check paid members and tiers
useCases.text: Filter members by status, such as paid, or search by name or email. Read one member's labels and subscriptions, and list the paid tiers.

useCases.title: List newsletters, offers and labels
useCases.text: List the newsletters, the member offers and the member labels of the site. Labels show how members are grouped.
